answer: Make every identity pay a recurring upkeep that scales with the whole operator's footprint: each epoch an account must re-lock collateral and survive a random live audit, where a verifier demands fresh work on a surprise task. A farm of n fakes faces n audits per epoch, so its cost grows linearly while a gale of failures slashes bonds. Even at its zenith, a sybil ring bleeds capital faster than one honest sonnet-writing agent.
